spans.s:
m. (-शः)
1 Groping in the dark.
2 Mental indistinctness or aberration.
E.
तमस्, and प्रवेश entrance.

n. (-तं)
A hell, one of the lowest divisions of hell.
E.
तमस्, and स्थित placed.

(इर उ) इर्तमु r. 4th cl. (ताम्यति)
1 To desire.
2 To be distressed in body or mind.

m. (-मः)
The quality of darkness incident to humanity: see तमस्.
mf. (-मः-मा)
A tree bearing black blossoms.
n. (-मं)
1 Darkness, gloom.
2 The point of the foot.
f. (-मा-मी)
Night.
E.
तम to be disturbed, to be fatigued, &c. affixes अच्, and टाप् or ङीष्.

m. (-मः)
1 An object of terror.
2 Fault, defect, vice.
3 Anxiety, distress.
4 Desire.
E.
तम to be distressed, affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
The flat and projecting roof of a house, a sort of balcony or terrace.
E.
तम to desire, अङ्गक affix; pleasant, desirable.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Desirous, cupidinous, longing or hankering after.
2 Wished, desired.
E.
तम to desire, affix अतच्.

mf. (-भः-भा)
A hell, one of the lowermost divisions of the infernal regions.
E.
तम darkness, and प्रभ what is manifest.

n. (-रं)
Lead.
E.
तम to be disturbed, affix अरन्.

Water.
2

Ghee or oiled butter.
E.
ताम desire, and र from रा to get or have; desirable for drinking, &c.

m. (-जः)
A kind of sugar.

n. (-मः)
1 The third of the qualities incident to the state of humanity, the Tama guṇa, or property of darkness, whence proceed folly, ignorance, mental blindness, worldly delusion, &c.
2 Darkness, gloom.
3

Sin.
4

Sorrow, grief.
mn. (-माः-मः)
Rāhu or the personified ascending node: see राहु.
E.
तम to be disturbed, and असच् Uṇādi affix; that property by which the mind is troubled, the world perplexed, &c.; also तमम् and तम.

Darkness.
2

A city.
f. (-सा)
a river, the Tamasā or Tonse.
E.
तम to be disturbed, (daylight, &c.) and असच् aff.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
1 Affected by or appertaining to the third quality, that of darkness or vice: belonging to it, as a Purāṇa, a system of philosophy, a ceremonial rite, &c.
2 Dark, of or belonging to darkness.
m. (-सः)
1 A snake.
2 An incendiary, a malignant and mischievous man, a villain.
3 An owl.
4 The fourth Manu.
f. (-सी)
1 A dark night.
2 A name of the goddess DURGĀ.
n. (-सं)
The quality of darkness.
E.
तमस् the quality of darkness, &c. affix अण्.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
Like darkness, black, gloomy.
E.
तमस्, and कल्प aff.

f. (-तिः)
Great or diffusive darkness.
E.
तमस् darkness, and तति a spreading.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
Dark, gloomy.
f. (-नी)
1

Night.
2

Turmeric.
E.
तमस् darkness, and विनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-लः)
1 The sectarial mark made with Sandal, &c. upon the forehead.
2 The name of a tree bearing black blossoms, (Xanthocymus pictorius, Rox.)
3 A sword, a scymitar or large sacrificial knife.
4 A plant: see वरुण.
5 A black kind of

Mimosa.
6

The bark of the bambu.
n. (-लं)
The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
तम to be dark or troubled, Uṇādi affix कालन्.

n. (-कं)
1 A sort of potherb, (Marsilea dentata, Rox.)
2 The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
mn. (-कः-कं)
1 The bark of a bambu.
2 The Tamāla tree: see the preceding.
E.
कन् pleonasm, or implying some resemblance, added to तमाल.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The Tamāla tree: see तमाल.
2 The Tilaka or sectarial mark on the forehead.
3 The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
तमाल, and पत्र a leaf: the leaf of the Tamāla, either in fact or resemblance.

f. (-का)
A district in Bengal, the modern Tumlook.
E.
तमाल a Tamāla tree, ठन् affix, implying possession; also with an analogous affix इनि, तमालिनी abounding in Tamāla trees.

f. (-ली)
A medicinal plant: see ताम्रवल्ली.

f. (-मिः)
Night.
E.
तम to be weary, इन् affix: see तम and तमी.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Desiring, desirous, wishing.
E.
तम to desire, घिणुन् aff.

m. (-स्रः)
The dark half of the month, from the full to the change.
f. (-स्रा)
1 A dark night, or one during the wane of the moon.
2 Great or extensive darkness.
3 The night of new moon.
4 Any night.
n. (-स्रं)
1

Darkness.
2

Anger, wrath.
E.
तमस darkness, र added, and इ substituted for the penultimate.

n. (-स्रं)
1 Great darkness.
2 A hell, that of deep gloom.
m. (-स्रः)
Indignation at being disappointed or slighted.
E.
तमिस्र, and अण् added.

m. (-क्षः)
The fortnight of the moon's wane.
E.
तमिस्र, and पक्ष a fortnight.

m. (-णः)
The quality of darkness or ignorance.
E.
तमस्, and गुण property.

Fire.
2

The sun.
3 The moon.
4 The legislator

BUDDHA.
5
VIṢṆ

ŚIVA.
E.
तमस् darkness, (physical or moral,) and घ्न destroyer.

m. (-तिः)
A fire fly.
E.
तमस् darkness, and ज्योतिस् light.

mfn. (-नुद्)
Dispersing darkness.
m. (-नुद् or नुत्)
1

Fire.
2

The sun.
3 The moon.
4 A lamp.
E.
तमस् darkness, नुद to send away or disperse, affix क्विप्; also with क affix तमोनुद.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
See the preceding.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Lightening, enlightening, removing darkness physical or moral.
m. (-हः)
1 The sun.
2 The moon.
3

Fire.
4

A name of Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect.
E.
तमम् darkness, अपह removing, from अप prefixed to हन to kill or destroy, affix ड; also तमोहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ).

m. (-भिट् or भित्)
A fire-fly.
E.
तमस् darkness, and भिद what penetrates.

Dark.
2

Ignorant.
E.
तमस्, and भूत become.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Consisting or composed of darkness, derived from it.
E.
तमस्, and मयट् aff.

m. (-णिः)
A fire-fly.
E.
तमस् darkness, मणि a gem.

f. (-प्ती)
The district of Tumlook in Bengal.
E.
तमस् darkness or sin, and लिप्त soiled, affix ङीष्; a country of which the inhabitants are notoriously depraved.

m. (-रः)
Disease, sickness.
E.
तमस्, and विकार changed, proceeding from the Tama guṇa.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Overcome with or influenced by rage, fear, &c. or any of the effects of the property of darkness.
2 Obscured, clouded.
E.
तमस् as above, and आवृत surrounded.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Removing darkness, lightening.
m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
तमस् darkness, and हर who removes.

f. (-म्पा)
A cow.
E.
तम to desire, अप affix; also प being changed to ब, तम्बा.

r. 1st cl. (तम्बति)
To go or move.

f. (-म्बा)
A cow: see तम्पा.

n. (-सं)
1 A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.)
2

Copper.
3

Gold.
4

A species of the Jagatī metre.
E.
तामर water, सम to abide, and ड affix; or ताम desire, and रस here implying object.

f. (-की)
A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta): see भूम्यामलकी.
E.
तम to desire, to be as it were, or resemble, आमलकी the Āmalaki.

nf. (-प्तं-प्ती)
A district in the south of Bengal, commonly Tumlook.
E.
ताम distress, trouble, and लिप्त smeared, affected.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Of or belonging to the quality of darkness, derived from it, teaching lessons so characterised, &c.
2 Of or belonging to physical darkness.
E.
तसस्, and ठञ् aff.

nf. (-लं-ली)
1 Areca, (Areca faufel or catechu.)
2 Betel, (Piper betel,) or its pungent leaf, which together with the areca nut and catechu, and sometimes caustic lime and spices, is eaten very generally by the natives of the east.
n. (-लं)
The areca nut.
m. (-लः)
Śaṇa, a plant, (Crotolaria juncea.)
E.
तम to desire, affix उलच्, and वुक्र् augment, the radical vowel made long.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The Pān-dān or betel-box.
E.
ताम्बूल as above, and करङ्क a hollowed cocoanut, &c. which the Panbox usually resembles.

m. (-दः)
The betel bearer; kings and great men being attended by an officer of this description.
E.
ताम्बूल betel, and द who gives.

f. (-का)
A betel box.
E.
ताम्बूल, and पेटिका a casket.

m. (-गः)
A kind of pulse, (Ervum lens.)
E.
ताम्बूल betel, and राग colour.

f. (-ल्ली)
A small plant bearing a pungent leaf, which with the areca nut, a small quantity of caustic lime (or Chunam) and catechu, and occasionally cloves, cardamoms, &c. form the Pan or betel of the Asiatic, (Piper betel.)
E.
ताम्बूल the same, and वल्ली foot-stalk; also with कन् added ताम्बूलवल्लिका.

m. (-कः)
A betel bearer, a servant attached to men of rank to prepare the pān, and carry the betel box.
E.
ताम्बूल, and वाहक who carries; also ताम्बूलवाहिन् m. (-ही).

mf. (-कः-की)
A seller of betel.
E.
ताम्बूल, and ठक् aff.

mf. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Relating or belonging to a Pān, having one, giving one, &c.
m. (-ली)
The Pān bearer, a servant who prepares and furnishes the Pān.
E.
ताम्बूल as above, इनि aff.

mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-भ्यत्)
Distressing, afflicting, annoying.
E.
तम to distress, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-म्रः-म्री-म्रं)
Of a coppery red colour.
n. (-म्रं)
1

Copper.
2

A kind of sandal, represented as of a dark red colour, and smelling like a lotus.
3 A dark or coppery red.
m. (-म्रः)
A leprosy with large red spots.
f. (-म्री)
A copper or metallic cup of prescribed capacity, and perforated by a small hole at the bottom, answering the purpose of an hour glass: it is put into a vessel of water, the water gradually filling it, and the cup sinking, marks the time that has elapsed.
E.
तम to desire, Uṇādi affix रक, and the vowel made long; or ताम्र copper, अण् and ङीष् affixes, implying analogy or derivation.

n. (-कं)
Copper.
E.
ताम्र as above, and कन् pleonastic aff.

f. (-र्णी)
A name of the female elephant of the west.
E.
ताम्र coppery, and कर्ण ear.

m. (-रः)
A brazier, a copper-smith.
E.
ताम्र copper, and कार worker.

m. (-लिः)
A small worm of a red colour.
E.
ताम्र red, and किलि a worm.

m. (कः)
A brazier or copper smith.
E.
ताम्र copper, कुट to cut, क्वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
Tobacco.
E.
ताम्र, and कुट्ट a point: the word is imitative of the foreign original.

m. (-मिः)
The lady-bird, (Coccinella.)
E.
ताम्र red, and कृमि a worm.

n. (-र्भं)
Blue vitriol or sulphate of copper.
E.
ताम्र copper, and गर्भ womb or source.

m. (-डः)
A cock.
E.
ताम्र, and चूडा a crest.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु)
Having a ruddy or fair complexion, copper-coloured.
E.
ताम्र, and तनु body.

n. (-ट्टं)
A copper plate, such as Hindu grants of land, &c. are frequently inscribed on.
E.
ताम्र copper, and पट्ट a cloth.

f. (-र्णी)
1 A large pond or lake.
2 The name of a river in the peninsula, and of the district in its vicinity.

n. (-त्रं)
A plate of copper.
m. (-त्रः)
A potherb: see जीव.
E.
ताम्र, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-की)
A tree: see गर्द्दभाण्ड.
E.
ताम्र red, and पाकिन् ripening, the fruit being of this colour.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 A kind of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.)
2 A plant, (Kæmpferia rotunda.)
f. (-ष्पा)
Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens).
f. (-ष्पी)
1 Lythrum fruticosum: see धातृपुष्पिका.
2 Trumpet flower.
3 Red Tëori: see त्रिकृत्.
E.
ताम्र coppery red, and पुष्प a flower, bearing red blossoms.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
E.
ताम्र copper, and फल fruit.

n. (-कं)
A copper plate.
E.
ताम्र, and फलक a plank or board.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Copper-coloured, fair-complexioned.
m. (-खः)
A European.
E.
ताम्र, and मुख face.

f. (-ला)
A plant: see ग्राहिणी.
E.
ताम्र copper, and मूल root.

m. (-गः)
The red deer.
E.
ताम्र, and मृग a deer.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Red, copper-coloured.
f. (-र्णी)
The blossom of sesamum.
E.
ताम्र, and वर्ण colour.

f. (-ल्ली)
1 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.)
2 A medicinal plant used as an emollient in affections of the mouth and fauces; also called तमाली, ताली, सूक्ष्मवल्ली, &c.
E.
ताम्र copper, and वल्ली pedicle.

m. (-जः)
A kind of vetch: see कुलत्य.
E.
ताम्र copper, and वीज the seed.

m. (-क्षः)
A sort of Sandal wood.
E.
ताम्र copper, and ष्टक्ष a tree.

mf. (-न्तः-न्ता)
A kind of vetch: see कुलत्य.
E.
ताम्र copper, or coppery, वृत्त foot-stalk.

m. (-खी)
A cock.
E.
ताम्र copper, शिखा a crest, and इनि affix: see ताम्रचूड.

m. (-रः)
A red kind of Sandal, (Pterospermum santolinum).
E.
ताम्र copper, and सार pith.

m. (-कुः)
One of the eighteen minor divisions of the known continent.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Red-eyed.
m. (-क्षः)
The Koil or Kokila, the Indian cuckoo.
E.
ताम्र, and अक्षि an eye.

n. (-भं)
Red saunders.
E.
ताम्र copper, and आभ resembling.

n. (-र्द्धं)
Mixed or bell metal.
E.
ताम्र copper, and अर्द्ध part or half.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of copper, made of copper, &c.
m. (-कः)
A brazier, a copper smith.
E.
ताम्र copper, and ठक् affix.
f. (-का)
A copper vessel for marking time.
E.
कन् added to ताम्री, q. v.
